name: Retry limit circuit breaker boundary (max_retry_count = 3)
description: Circuit-breaker boundary at the HTTP layer. retry_count=2 (below limit) reaches the agent normally; retry_count=3 (at limit) and retry_count=5 (above limit) short-circuit to HTTP 429 with DONT_RETRY, confidence 1.0, and an explanation containing 'Max retry limit reached' - without invoking the LLM.

api_requests.label: below_limit

request.failure_reason: Simulated upstream failure for E2E testing

expected_response.explanation: The beneficiary bank (DEUTDEFF) is ONLINE and the account DE89370400440532013000 is ACTIVE. The NETWORK_TIMEOUT appears transient and this is still within the allowed retry budget, so the transaction can be retried now.

api_requests.notes: Below the limit: normal agent flow, any valid recommendation except DONT_RETRY.

api_requests.label: at_limit

request.failure_reason: Simulated upstream failure for E2E testing

expected_response.explanation: Max retry limit reached. The transaction has already been retried 3 times, which meets the configured maximum (max_retry_count=3). No further retries will be attempted.

api_requests.notes: At the limit: circuit breaker trips, LLM is NOT invoked. Explanation must contain 'Max retry limit reached'; confidence exactly 1.0.

api_requests.label: over_limit

request.failure_reason: Simulated upstream failure for E2E testing

expected_response.explanation: Max retry limit reached. The transaction has already been retried 5 times, exceeding the configured maximum (max_retry_count=3). No further retries will be attempted.

api_requests.notes: Exceeding the limit: same 429 behaviour as at the limit.
